lyophilised: Lyophilised means used of tissue or blood or serum or other biological substances.
Lyophilised means the same as lyophilized or freeze-dried.
lyophilized: Lyophilized means used of tissue or blood or serum or other biological substances.
Lyophilized means the same as lyophilised or freeze-dried.
lyrate: Lyrate means having curvature suggestive of a lyre.
lyre-shaped: Lyre-shaped means shaped like a lyre.
lyrical: Lyrical means suitable for or suggestive of singing.
Lyrical can also mean expressing deep emotion.
Lyrical means the same as lyric.
lysogenic: Lysogenic means of or relating to lysogeny.
Lysogenic can also mean capable of producing or undergoing lysis.
lyrically: Lyrically means in a lyrical manner.
For example: "She danced the part of the Black Swan very lyrically."
